chubb_second_adjudication.unit: Two filing-specific opportunities refer to one economic loss estimate. Repeats within a filing count once; the later disclosure is a reaffirmation. Wrong amount or event is an incorrect automatic mention; incomplete basis, status, economic quarter or owner means no complete credit even if amount and event are supported.
chubb_second_adjudication.caveat: Three versions each produce one valid quarterly mention and no annual mention, even though the amount is disclosed separately for Ian alongside a separate Elliott amount. Gross/net of reinsurance left unspecified as in the source; no credit deducted for that abstention. One economic exposure, two filing-specific opportunities.
chubb_second_adjudication.time_convention: Two preexisting scoring formulations are named explicitly. Strict economic-time completeness requires an explicit normalized economic-period field. Accounting-period completeness accepts the normalized reporting quarter, its source, plus the source sentence explicitly saying current quarter; v4 and v5 provide this for BQ, v3 does not normalize the reporting quarter. Neither convention converts a report date by itself into occurrence time.
